content: Friend recommendation is a popular method to help users to make new friends and discover interesting information. Friend recommendation is a relative challenging issue contrasted with group or item recommendations in online social networksBIBREF70, BIBREF41, BIBREF71. To address this challenge issue, a recent work in [79] proposed a friend recommendation based on LDA, which contains two stages: first step, they applied tag-user information to produce a possible friend list and then they created a topic model to demonstrate the relationship between user's friend making behaviour and image features. They applied experiments on the Flickr as a standard dataset and showed that their recommends friends more quickly than traditional methods.
